tropical_outlook: Quiet. The latest NHC Atlantic outlook found (Nov 24, 2026) expects no tropical cyclone formation in the North Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf during the next 7 days, and no Atlantic cyclones are active; the season ends Nov 30. A Nov 25 issuance was not confirmed. The only feature mentioned is a Central Pacific low about 1,000 miles southwest of Hawaii (20% formation chance), which affects no venue. No tropical threat to Miami, Jacksonville, Tampa or Houston. South Florida's heavy rain this week was a non-tropical frontal system.
general_notes: No neutral-site or international games this week; all 16 are at the home team's stadium.

Only WebSearch result summaries were available (no direct page fetch). Search-result page ages were often unreliable, so aggregator numbers (nflweather.com, weathernfl.com, mysportsweather.com) are cross-checked where possible and confidence is marked low where no dated local/NWS forecast was found.
wind_mph values for PHI_DAL, DEN_PIT, NYJ_MIA, TEN_JAX, SEA_SF and CAR_TB are estimates (no numeric sustained wind in results); see notes.
Retractable-roof status (DAL, HOU, IND, ARI) is an expectation; no official roof announcements were found.
Weekend games (Sun/Mon) are 4-5 days out; recheck Cleveland, Santa Clara, Cincinnati and Pittsburgh closer to kickoff.

2026_12_PHI_DAL.notes: Retractable roof. 2026_12_KC_BUF.conditions: Cold rain through the evening, breezy from the east-northeast
2026_12_KC_BUF.notes: NWS via current-week game articles: rain developing after 1 PM Thursday, high near 43F, rain continuing Thursday night, low about 36F. NE wind 7-10 mph sustained, gusts 21 mph (other sources up to 28 mph). Wind is from the ENE, opposite the usual SW lake wind. No lake-effect snow expected during the game. precip_chance_pct=80 is inferred from the categorical 'rain' wording (no explicit PoP in results). Kickoff temp ~38-40F, falling.

2026_12_DEN_PIT.conditions: Cold with light rain, possibly mixing with wet snow; breezy
2026_12_DEN_PIT.notes: Sources disagree. WTAE (Nov 24) calls Thanksgiving and Friday 'Impact Days': soggy, cold and windy, light rain and a snowflake or two Friday, drying for the weekend. weathernfl.com lists 37F, 66% precip, snow possible, but only 2 mph wind. Other pages: highs 42-43F with PoP anywhere from 20% to 70%. No Pittsburgh-specific gust number found; strongest gusts (35-55 mph) are forecast for the western slopes of the mountains, not the city. wind_mph=12 is a midpoint estimate between '2 mph' and 'windy'; treat wind as the main unknown. Accumulating snow not expected in the city (light accumulation possible in the Laurel Highlands).

2026_12_NO_CIN.conditions: Cool and mostly cloudy with a chance of showers
2026_12_NO_CIN.notes: NFLWeather (updated ~Nov 23): 53F, 29% rain. mysportsweather: 53F, 10 mph wind with gusts 17 (text says 10-15 sustained, gusts near 25), 45% rain. WCPO daily: 52/37F, 24% precip. PoP range 24-45%, 35 used. Rain risk tied to a system that WPC expects to bring rain to the eastern third early next week; timing could shift.

2026_12_LV_CLE.conditions: Chilly, breezy lakefront night with a chance of rain showers
2026_12_LV_CLE.notes: No dated local (NWS Cleveland / TV) forecast for Sunday night was found. Aggregators: NFLWeather 45F with 40% rain; weathernfl.com 48F with 53% rain; WKYC extended page 49/38F, 60% precip, S wind 16 mph (page cache date unclear). No gust figure found. WPC extended discussion (Nov 24): a clipper may phase with a southern trough, bringing rain to the East early next week followed by lake-effect snow on the back side; that change looks to arrive after the game, but timing is uncertain. Recheck Saturday.

2026_12_SEA_SF.conditions: Rain likely and breezy as a second Pacific storm arrives
2026_12_SEA_SF.notes: NWS Santa Clara Valley zone forecast: rain Sunday, highs lower 60s, rain likely Sunday night. NWS San Francisco point forecast: 'Rain. Cloudy, high near 62. Breezy.' NBC Bay Area: dry Thanksgiving and Friday, rain returns Saturday into Sunday with gusty winds. Aggregators: NFLWeather 80% rain, 62F; weathernfl.com 59% rain, 65F. No numeric wind or gust figure for Santa Clara found; 15 mph is taken from the NWS 'breezy' wording (15-25 mph) and the South Bay is usually less windy than the city. Kickoff is 1:25 PM local. Wettest outdoor game of the week on current guidance.
